component-o.not_supply_pins_note-s: pin 11 VCC is the output of the TPS61288's internal regulator (SLVSFP3C Table 6-1 p4: 'A ceramic capacitor of more than 1.0 uF is required between this pin and ground'), not a supply input
component-o.description-s: 18-V, 15-A fully integrated synchronous boost converter, 2.0-18 V in, adjustable 4.5-18 V out (configured 6.92 V), fixed 500 kHz, external loop compensation, automatic PFM at light load

pins_source-o.table-s: Table 6-1 Pin Functions: FB 1, COMP 2, PGND 3, SW 4,9, VOUT 5, EN 6, VIN 7, BST 8, AGND 10, VCC 11

component-o.stdpins_note-s: Figure 9-1 (p13, 3.6 V to 13 V / 2.3 A): C1 10 uF input and C5 0.1 uF at the VIN pin ('A 0.1-uF ceramic bypass capacitor is recommended as close as possible to the VIN pin', p15). C4 6 x 22 uF output. L1 2.2 uH from VIN to SW. C2 0.1 uF BST to SW ('A ceramic capacitor of 0.1 uF must be connected between this pin and the SW pin', Table 6-1 p4). C3 2.2 uF on VCC. Inductor: the sheet says to 'select the inductor with saturation current higher than the setting current limit' (p15). The current limit is fixed at 12 / 15 / 17.1 A, so the saturation rating must be at least 17.1 A (see l_isat_min_ma). Table 9-2 (p15) recommends CMLE105T-2R2MS-99 (2.2 uH, 26.0 A saturation). Output capacitors: rated 22 uF each. Choose a voltage rating that keeps the effective total inside the cout_min_nf..cout_max_nf range at 6.92 V (p15: 'leave margin on the voltage rating to ensure adequate effective capacitance').

cfgpins-ao.6c: EN: 'Logic high level enables the device' (Table 6-1 p4). Internal pull-down REN 850 kohm min (7.5 Electrical Characteristics p6), so a floating EN stays off. Tied to VIN for always-on, as the TPS61088 record does; Figure 9-1 shows an ON/OFF control, so a GPIO may drive it instead (VIH 1.2 V, VIL 0.4 V).

cfgpins-ao.1c: Feedback divider R1 137 kohm (VOUT to FB) and R2 13.0 kohm (FB to ground), both E96. Equation 1 (p14): R1 = (VOUT - VREF) x R2 / VREF, with VREF 0.6 V typ (0.588 / 0.6 / 0.612 V, 7.5 Electrical Characteristics p6). For 6.92 V: (6.92 - 0.6) / 0.6 x 13.0k = 136.9k, so 137k. VOUT = 0.6 x (1 + 137/13.0) = 6.923 V typ, 6.785 to 7.062 V over the VREF limits. R2 is below 15 kohm, so C6 (27 pF across R2, 'Recommend adding C6 when R2>15k', Figure 9-1) is not needed. R2 is also below the p14 limit 'R2 should be smaller than 300 k'.

cfgpins-ao.2c: Loop compensation from COMP to AGND ('the loop compensation network should be connected between this pin and the AGND pin', Table 6-1 p4): RC 36.5 kohm in series with CC 5.6 nF, plus CP 30 pF in parallel. Computed with 9.2.2.5 Loop Stability (p16-17) at the board's worst case: VIN 3.0 V, VOUT 6.92 V, IOUT 2.3 A, L 2.2 uH, CO 6 x 22 uF = 132 uF rated. D = 1 - VIN/VOUT = 0.5665, so (1-D) = 0.4335. RO = 6.92/2.3 = 3.009 ohm. fRHPZ = RO x (1-D)^2 / (2 pi L) (Equation 10) = 3.009 x 0.1879 / (2 pi x 2.2 uH) = 40.9 kHz. Crossover rule (p17): fC no higher than the lower of fSW/10 (44 kHz at the 440 kHz minimum fSW) or fRHPZ/5 (8.18 kHz), so the limit is 8.18 kHz. fC is chosen at 4.0 kHz with CO 132 uF. That leaves the crossover at about 8.0 kHz, still under 8.18 kHz, if DC bias halves the effective CO (rc_sizing_note-s). Equation 12: RC = 2 pi x VOUT x CO x fC / ((1-D) x VREF x GEA x KCOMP) = 2 pi x 6.92 x 132e-6 x 4000 / (0.4335 x 0.6 x 180e-6 x 13.5) = 22.96 / 6.320e-4 = 36.3 kohm, so 36.5k. GEA 180 uS and KCOMP 13.5 A/V come from 7.5 Electrical Characteristics p6. Equation 13: CC = RO x CO / (2 RC) = 3.009 x 132e-6 / 73.0e3 = 5.44 nF, so 5.6 nF. Equation 14: CP = RESR x CO / RC, and 'If the calculated value of CP is less than 10 pF, it can be left open' (p17). The ESR of six ceramic capacitors is not stated, so CP is fitted at Figure 9-1's 30 pF. Its pole is at 1/(2 pi x 36.5k x 30p) = 145 kHz, far above fC. Fitted values (klayout-c9 2026-11-06, procurement): CC 4.7 nF (C0603C472K5RACTU) and CP 33 pF (C0603C330J5GACTU), the nearest values whose ltl.db rows carry ESR / ESL / DC-bias data, in place of the computed 5.6 nF / 30 pF: the CC zero moves from 1 / (2 pi 36.5k 5.6n) = 779 Hz to 1 / (2 pi 36.5k 4.7n) = 928 Hz, still more than 4x below the 4 kHz crossover; the CP pole from 145 kHz to 1 / (2 pi 36.5k 33p) = 132 kHz.

specs-o.softstart_note-s: internal soft start, no SS pin: 'When the EN pin is pulled high, the internal soft-start capacitor is charged' (8.3.1 p11); TSS 3 ms typ at VIN 7.2 V, VOUT 16 V, Cout(eff) 50 uF (7.5 Electrical Characteristics p6)
specs-o.vout_set_note-s: This record is configured for the board's 6.92 V (power.json BOOST_RAW, owner's figure). The TPS61088 record said 7.0 V. The 137k/13.0k divider gives 6.923 V typ. Only the 6.92 V figure was used.

l_isat_source-o.table-s: 9.2.2.2 Inductor Selection: 'Set the current limit of the TPS61288 higher than the peak current, ILpeak. Then select the inductor with saturation current higher than the setting current limit.' The limit is fixed; 17.1 A is its maximum (p6)

specs-o.l_range_note-s: 9.2.2.2 p14: 'designed to work with inductor values between 1.0 and 4.7 uH'. 7.3 Recommended Operating Conditions p5: 'L Effective inductance range 0.8 5.6 uH' (two figures, columns not resolvable from the text layer). 2.2 uH chosen as in Figure 9-1.

inductor_peak_derived-o.note-s: Derived with Equations 2-4 (p14-15) at VIN 3.0 V, VOUT 6.92 V, IOUT 2.3 A, efficiency 0.90, L 2.2 uH -30% = 1.54 uH, fSW min 440 kHz. p14 says to use 'the minimum switching frequency, the inductor value with -30% tolerance, and a low-power conversion efficiency'. The 0.90 efficiency is a chosen design figure: the sheet gives none at 6.92 V, and the bracketing curves read 91.5% (13 V, VIN 2.7 V, 2 A) and 94.8% (5.5 V, VIN 2.3 V, 2 A). IDC = 6.92 x 2.3 / (3.0 x 0.90) = 5.895 A. IPP = 1 / (L x (1/(VOUT-VIN) + 1/VIN) x fSW) = 2.508 A. ILpeak = 7.149 A, below the 12 A minimum limit.

load_regulation-ao.slope_note-s: derived over 0.5 to 2.3 A (PWM region up to the board load): (5492.4 - 5493.1 mV) gives +0.7 mV / 1.8 A = +0.39 mV/A. The output RISES with load. Below 0.5 A (PFM) it falls 1.2 mV from 10 mA to 0.5 A. Total excursion from 10 mA to 2.3 A: 1.2 mV (0.02%).

load_regulation-ao.slope_note-s: derived over 0.5 to 2.3 A: 13028.9 to 13046.8 mV gives +17.9 mV / 1.8 A = +9.94 mV/A (0.14% of 13 V). The output RISES with load, not droops.

specs-o.load_regulation_note-s: 6.92 V has no curve; bracketed by 5.5 V and 13 V, the larger used. The larger is +9.94 mV/A at 13 V (Figure 7-2, p8), rounded to 10. The sign is positive: the output rises with load over 0.5-2.3 A. The magnitude is the figure to use as |Rout| = 10 mohm.

specs-o.crossover_eq-s: fC = RC x (1 - D) x VREF x GEA x KCOMP / (2 x pi x VOUT x CO), Equation 12 rearranged; (1 - D) = VIN / VOUT; RC the COMP resistor fitted; CO the effective output capacitance

crossover_eq_source-o.table-s: 9.2.2.5 Loop Stability, Equation 12: 'RC = 2 pi x VOUT x CO x fC / ((1-D) x VREF x GEA x KCOMP)'. GEA 'Gm Error amplifier trans conductance 180 uS' and 'KCOMP Power stage trans-conductance ... 13.5 A / V' from 7.5 Electrical Characteristics p6; VREF 0.6 V p6

specs-o.loop_crossover_max_rule-s: fC no higher than the lower of fSW/10 or fRHPZ/5, with fRHPZ = RO x (1-D)^2 / (2 pi L) (Equation 10, p17). Quote: 'loop gain cross over no higher than the lower of either 1/10 of the switching frequency, fSW, or 1/5 of the RHPZ frequency' (p17). Also 'greater than 45 deg of phase margin and greater than 10-dB gain margin' (p17). External compensation, so the crossover is a design choice.

loop_design_derived-o.rc_sizing_note-s: Derived at VIN 3.0 V, IOUT 2.3 A, L 2.2 uH, CO 132 uF rated, RC 36.5k: fC = 4.02 kHz. The effective CO at 6.92 V depends on the capacitor picked and is not known here. fC scales as 1/CO_eff: it is 8.04 kHz at CO_eff 66 uF and passes the 8.18 kHz limit at about 65 uF. Below that, raise CO or lower RC. With L at -30% (1.54 uH), fRHPZ = 58.4 kHz and the limit rises to 11.7 kHz.
